_readme: Bento's own list of vetted payloads. Every copy of the app reads this file (at most every few hours) and shows these under Get payloads > Bento's picks. Add an entry to offer a new payload without an app update; set "hidden": true to take one off. Fields: repo (GitHub owner/repo with Releases), name, console (ps5 or ps4), file (the file to take from a release or from the zip in it), anyFirmware (true for plain tools that run on any firmware), about (text, or {"en": ..., "de": ...} per language; built-in entries keep their translated text).

payloads.name: ps5-app-dumper
payloads.about: Copies an installed game's files to a USB drive plugged into the console.

payloads.name: PKG-Manager
payloads.about: Installs .pkg files on the console itself, from a USB drive, a disc or a network share.
